title: GTA 6 Hype Boosts PS5 and Xbox Console Sales by 30%
description: According to Eurogamer, the anticipation for GTA 6 is already driving a much-needed 30% sales boost for PlayStation and Xbox consoles in the UK.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Hype Boosts PS5 and Xbox Console Sales by 30%

The hype surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming masterpiece, GTA 6, is already making waves in the hardware market. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the anticipation for the game is giving PlayStation and Xbox consoles a much-needed 30% sales boost, at least in the UK.

### A Much-Needed Catalyst for Hardware

Even though Rockstar Games' inevitable pile of cash and the game's official launch are still a couple of months away, the sheer gravity of GTA 6 is already influencing consumer behavior. Hardware sales for current-gen platforms have experienced a notable lift as players begin preparing well in advance for what is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of the decade.

### Preparing for the Next Big Experience

This early surge in console purchases highlights how powerful a single, generational franchise can be for the entire gaming ecosystem. Fans are clearly looking to secure their hardware early, ensuring they are fully equipped the moment they can step foot back into the game's expansive world.

### Editor's Take

It is remarkable to see GTA 6 driving hardware sales months before release. A 30% boost proves that consumer excitement is at an all-time high, showing once again that Rockstar's powerhouse franchise remains the ultimate system-seller of the modern gaming era.
